authority.sourceRights: 40-evidence-and-trust/Educational Content Source Licensing and Provenance Standard.md

derivation.rule: Keep Course Truth and Exam Truth single-source. Build the learner corpus deterministically from rights-safe subject truth plus the approved Blueprint rather than copying the truth layer into a second manually maintained content store.
derivation.groupingRule: Learn is assembled as one coherent chapter per current topic with traceable requirement sections. Practice count is exactly the set of Blueprint-selected evidence modes. Exam Prep topic sets cover the distinct Blueprint-selected question families/demand classes for each topic. These are coverage consequences, not fixed commercial quotas.
derivation.regenerationRule: If Course Truth, Exam Truth or Blueprint inputs change, regenerate/reassure the affected learner corpus rather than patching around stale truth.

learn.evidenceBoundary: Learn is exposure/review only. Learner-facing teaching does not create readiness evidence by itself.

practice.rule: Every selected Practice mode must have an active learner task plus a rights-safe feedback anchor. Step 4 does not create scored readiness claims before Step 5 builds the applicable Marking Packs/evidence mappings.

examPrep.paperSimulationRule: The simulations reproduce current structured paper/section/option facts but use independently authored Revision prompts. The chosen tariff mix is representative practice, not a claim about a fixed future AQA paper pattern.

rights.subjectTruth: Only rights-safe Course Truth fields and their retained OPEN/LICENSED/REVISION_OWNED provenance may feed teaching/feedback copy.
rights.boardAlignment: May determine scope, placement and metadata but is not a learner-text corpus.

completionBoundary.step4CompleteMeans: The full 17-topic Learn corpus, all Blueprint-selected active Practice modes, the six exam-skill modules, topic Exam Prep coverage and representative three-paper Revision simulations are deterministically producible with exact provenance and no known input blocker.
